name: tomx-gala
description: A young Latino man, 185 cm, LANKY: long legs, a narrow chest, slim arms with a little shape, shoulders slightly broader than a skinny boy's, and a small soft belly that rounds his T-shirt at the waist and shows as a soft curve above the belt in side views. LIGHT BROWN sun-tanned skin (a light tan, clearly not dark). Dark brown hair cropped short with loose curls on top. Dark brown heavy-lidded eyes, a wide easy mouth, light stubble along the jaw. His palms are noticeably lighter, bleached by solvent. A stack of steel bearing rings on his LEFT wrist ONLY - never on the right. One small brass ear stud. Age 25, OUTFIT (the gala): a borrowed charcoal-brown suit worn OPEN, the jacket not closing over his small belly, its sleeves turned back once so a white shirt cuff shows; a white dress shirt with the collar open, two buttons undone, no tie; slim charcoal-brown suit trousers; ACID-YELLOW socks that show above the shoes; glossy black leather derby shoes. No harness, no gilet, no work boots. BOTH HANDS EMPTY in every view unless the pose itself uses them: nothing held, no props. No hat, no glasses, no watch, no gloves, no tattoos. PRONOUNS: the view library's prompts say 'she/her'; this character is a MAN - every view must be drawn as him (see _next_session).
